### [Persona Name]

- **Primary goal:** <!-- what they need to accomplish -->
- **Key behaviors:** <!-- how they interact with similar products -->

- **Constraints:** <!-- device, accessibility, proficiency level -->
- **Success looks like:** <!-- observable outcome from their perspective -->

## 3. Success criteria

<!-- HOW we know it worked. Every criterion must be measurable.

2. [Metric]: [Target] within [Timeframe]
3. [Metric]: [Target] within [Timeframe]

**Alternate paths:**

**Error states:**

## 6. Non-functional requirements

<!-- Quality attributes with measurable thresholds. Omit categories that don't apply.
     These generate dedicated infrastructure/security/accessibility stories via /ideate.
     Combined with Section 7 boundaries, these form the sprint Definition of Done.
     Feeds into: Definition of Done, infrastructure stories, sprint-end validation -->

- **Performance:** <!-- e.g., API responses < 200ms at P95 under 500 req/s -->
- **Security:** <!-- e.g., all PII encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3) -->
- **Accessibility:** <!-- e.g., WCAG 2.2 AA; keyboard navigable; screen reader compatible -->
- **Observability:** <!-- e.g., structured JSON logging; error alerting for P99 > 500ms -->
- **Scalability:** <!-- e.g., handle 10x current load via horizontal scaling -->
- **Compatibility:** <!-- e.g., last 2 versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari; iOS 16+ -->

## 7. Scope boundaries

<!-- What this is NOT. Prevents AI scope creep — the most common AI failure mode.
     Loaded by /story-cycle as implementation guard rails.
     Feeds into: agent boundary configuration, /ideate non-goals, /story-cycle scope check -->

**Non-goals (out of scope):**
- [Feature/capability explicitly excluded and why]
- [Feature/capability explicitly excluded and why]

**Implementation boundaries:**
- Always: <!-- required behaviors — run tests, follow conventions -->
- Ask first: <!-- decisions needing review — schema changes, new dependencies -->
- Never: <!-- forbidden actions — modify auth, commit secrets, delete data -->
